public.title: Rotate Image
public.description: Return an n by n integer matrix rotated clockwise by 90 degrees. This function returns the rotated value rather than requiring in-place mutation. n is 0 to 50; entries are between -1000 and 1000.
hints: Map each output row and column back to the input.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Output position (r,c) reads input position (n-1-c,r). O(n squared) time and output space.
